palette: casting-earth ground + molten bronze plaques + charcoal frame + seal-red inscription accents + pale rubbing insets
typography: molten headings on bronze panels, dark foundry label tabs with seal-red left bar, seal-red stamps for first-and-second verdicts, pale insets for quotation text, thin ink underline for dates
composition: the two castings face off as twin cauldron plaques with date stamps; the fajing scene lays six chapters as a scroll strip; the shang-yang scene reform inscribes four reform measures on a casting plate
surface: flat casting earth ground with faint mold hairlines, bronze panels with hairline weathered borders and corner rivets, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: cauldrons cast with a settle, date stamps land once, the scroll strip unfolds left to right, reform lines carve in sequence
transition: molten bronze pours and the foundry clears for the next casting
